_comment: What the composer's engine ACTUALLY plays for each event the Game Master assigned in the wiki (EVENT_ASSIGNMENTS in composer/engine/api.ts, generated by scripts/build-assignments.mjs). An assignment OUTRANKS EVENT_FOLEY and bindings.json, so this file — not those — is the truth for any event listed here. `sound` is a catalog id or composer/<set>, optionally naming ONE recording as composer/<set>/<take>, composer/<set>#<take>, or a separate `take` field.
